## History

Before the events of the series, George married Diana's mother, a union that those around him initially doubted would be suitable. Beyond his past marriage, he remains a background figure in the lives of the residents of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). His ongoing life and relationships are noted by those who know his family, though he does not directly participate in the immediate events surrounding [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P30](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0030), [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001), [v3 ch.Interlude P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004), [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), +31 more_

## Relationships

### [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anthony-pye--george.md)

George is Anthony Pye's uncle. Their familial connection establishes a direct blood relationship between the two characters.

- Relative of — uncle and nephew  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george--gilbert-blythe.md)

George is related to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as an uncle by marriage through Gilbert's aunt. This familial tie connects George to Gilbert's extended family network.

- Relative of — uncle by marriage to Gilbert's aunt  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>

### [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george--pacifique.md)

George holds a position of authority over [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md). In this dynamic, George issues commands that [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) is expected to follow.

- Commands  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P19](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0019)</sub>
